描述_EN: they are faced with white linen printed with a small black design (european). the silk outer layer of the jacket is attached to a linen inside layer which fits the body closely and ties together with its five original linen tapes. to create width below the waist, two gores have been inserted on each side of the bodice while the seamed panel down the back ends in a full pleated peplum at centre back. the sleeves are full-length and fasten at the wrist with two buttons. the skirts thus created are lined with plain white silk taffeta.
描述_ZN: 他们的表面是白色亚麻布，印有一个小的黑色设计（欧洲）。 外套的丝绸外层与亚麻内层相连，亚麻内层与身体紧密贴合，并用五条原始亚麻带系在一起。 为了创造腰部以下的宽度，在上衣的每一侧都插入了两个孔，而后面的缝合板在中心位置以一个完整的褶皱褶结束。 袖子是全长的，在手腕处用两个纽扣扣住。 这样产生的裙子是用普通的白色丝绸塔夫绸衬托的。
